notes.title: language update
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43111424/174b1bcf1ddd3d80195ba2b2548cb81f62c799b2.png

Americas Tower Simulator has been translated into:

English
Simplified Chinese
French
Italian
Japanese
German
Russian
Portuguese

Our goal is to make Americas Tower Simulator accessible to everyone!

Important:

Only the user interface has been translated into the aforementioned languages. Voiceovers and voice commands are currently only available in English. In the future, we plan to implement voice recognition for all the aforementioned languages.

notes.title: Version 1.5 (Demo) is cleared to make a straight in approach!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43111424/a7779498a23e78618f1a8b9716905f78cd17151a.png

We are glad to announce that version 1.5 (Demo) is clear to make a straight in approach!

features added:

-Porcedural voice recognition (English only)
-Radar View (Ground, Air)
-Airdrome Tour online (available in full version)
-VFR Flights (Available in full version)
-New airdrome design

Americas tower simulator is been made with great passion for aviation, our goal is to deliver a product we can feel proud of.  A product in which you can feel like an Air Traffic Controller.

We want to let you know that our shift have not ended yet, and we will continue working to deliver a full product this year 2023.

Thanks for all your help and support up until this point, we truly appreaciated it! 

Dev Team
